events.title: The Umayyads defeat the supporters of Ibn al-Zubayr at Marj Rahit
events.description: During the Second Fitna, the Umayyad caliph Marwan I and his Kalb allies defeated the Qays tribes, who backed the Mecca-based caliph Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, north of Damascus. The victory secured Syria for the Umayyads but fuelled a long Qays–Kalb feud.

events.title: Genghis Khan dies during his campaign against the Tangut
events.description: Genghis Khan died during the siege of the Western Xia, traditionally on this date. He had built the Mongol Empire, which under his heirs became the largest contiguous land empire in history.

events.title: Philip IV of France fights the Flemish at Mons-en-Pévèle
events.description: South of Lille, the army of Philip IV of France fought the Flemish militias that had defeated the French at Kortrijk two years earlier. The Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge of 1305 afterwards imposed heavy penalties on Flanders.

events.title: Nebrija dates the preface of the first Spanish grammar
events.description: Elio Antonio de Nebrija dated the introduction to his Gramática de la lengua castellana, written in Salamanca and the first grammar of a modern European language, writing that language was always the companion of empire. He presented it to Queen Isabella I.

events.title: Henry of Navarre marries Margaret of Valois in Paris
events.description: The Protestant Henry of Navarre married the Catholic princess Margaret, sister of Charles IX, a union meant to reconcile France's factions. Six days later the St Bartholomew's Day massacre began.

events.title: Solar eclipse observations reveal the element later named helium
events.description: Observing a total solar eclipse in India, Jules Janssen saw an unexplained yellow line in the Sun's spectrum. Norman Lockyer attributed it to a new element, helium, not found on Earth until 1895.

events.title: Tennessee ratifies the 19th Amendment, giving US women the vote
events.description: Tennessee became the 36th state to ratify, by one vote cast by a young legislator heeding his mother's letter. The amendment barred denial of the vote on account of sex.

events.title: James Meredith graduates from the University of Mississippi
events.description: James Meredith became the first Black graduate of Ole Miss. His enrolment in 1962 had provoked a deadly riot and required thousands of federal troops to enforce.
